_dtiam_model_paths_comment: Populate these only after running code/train_models.sh (or code/train_dtiam_models.py), which writes trained AutoGluon predictors to models/<task>_<dataset>/. Leave a task empty/omit it to skip predictions for that task.
_feature_builder_comment: Required whenever dtiam_model_paths is set: bermol_model_path is the pretrained compound encoder (BerMolModel_base.pkl), and protein_features_path is the ESM-2 protein_features.pkl produced by code/data_process/extract_feature.py for whichever dataset's targets you're scoring against (its keys must match the ids used in 'targets' above).

bayesian_opt.comment: Set strategy to 'bayesian_opt' for target-conditioned latent-space optimization. Requires a generator backend with encode()/decode() support and a dtiam_model_paths entry for the optimized task.

genetic_algorithm.comment: Set strategy to 'genetic_algorithm' for target-conditioned graph-based GA optimization (RDKit atom mutation + fragment crossover). Works with any generator/no generator at all -- only needs seed_smiles and a dtiam_model_paths entry for the optimized task.
